test_name: Validate External Navigation to Swagger API Page
description: Verify that clicking the link to the Swagger API page navigates the user to the correct external URL.
steps: Navigate to the API documentation page at https://dev.roost.ai/docs/api.
Locate the link pointing to the Swagger API page.
Verify that the link is visible and enabled.
Click on the Swagger API link.
Wait for the external page to load completely.
Verify that the user is navigated to the Swagger API page at https://dev.roost.ai/api/swagger.
Confirm the presence of Swagger interface elements such as endpoint lists and interactive testing tools.
expected_results: The user is successfully redirected to the Swagger API page.
All Swagger interface elements are visible and functional.
edge_cases: The Swagger API link is not visible or enabled.
The Swagger API link redirects to an incorrect page.
The external Swagger API page fails to load.
The browser blocks external navigation due to security settings.
The Swagger interface elements are not displayed on the destination page.
data_requirements: Access to the API documentation page at https://dev.roost.ai/docs/api.
A valid user session (if authentication is required).
No ad-blockers or extensions interfering with navigation.
dependencies: The Swagger API link must be implemented on the API documentation page.
The external Swagger API page must be accessible and functional.
Navigation to external URLs must be configured correctly in the application.
performance_metrics: Page load time for the external Swagger API page.
Time taken for the link to respond to the click event.
accessibility_requirements: The Swagger API link must have a descriptive aria-label.
The navigation action must be accessible via keyboard (e.g., Tab and Enter keys).
The external page must support screen readers.
